turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Hi Marcus! How is your Monday starting off? Did you and Grace have a good weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey! Yes, we had a pretty relaxing weekend. Today started off busy, but I made sure to have some oatmeal for breakfast before heading out to the school.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Oatmeal is always a solid, reliable start. How are things looking at the science department today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Quite busy with prep for the upcoming finals, but manageable. I actually managed to slip away after work and hit the gym for some weights.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That's great you found time for gym weights! It must be a nice way to decompress after managing the department all day. Did you get any tennis in over the weekend?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I did! Played a couple of sets on Saturday morning. My serve felt a bit off, but it was just good to be out there on the court.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Nice! Practice makes perfect. How is Olive doing? Is she still keeping you company when you're working on your woodworking projects?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: She is. She mostly just naps on the wood shavings, which isn't the safest, so I have to keep a close eye on her! Tonight she's curled up next to me while I watch some sitcom reruns.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Classic sitcom reruns are the perfect way to wind down on a Monday. Which show are you revisiting tonight?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just some old episodes of Seinfeld. I've seen them a million times, but they still make me laugh and don't require too much focus after a long day.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: You can't go wrong with Seinfeld. How is your neighbor's vegetable garden coming along, by the way? Have they started planting for the spring yet?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They actually have! I saw them putting in some tomato starts yesterday. It's making me wish I had a green thumb, but I'll stick to woodworking. Anyway, I'm going to get back to my show. Talk to you tomorrow!
